question: Worldwide, which kills the most people each year: terrorism, murder, suicide or road crashes?
answer: Road crashes, about 1.2 million a year, then suicide at about 727,000. Fear follows what is reported: a terror attack fills the news for days, a suicide almost never makes it. Yet suicide kills about one and a half times as many people as murder, and terrorism kills under 2% as many as murder.
move: Before fearing a danger, compare it with the dull ones beside it.
source: WHO, UNODC and Global Terrorism Index
reference: WHO (2023) Global status report on road safety 2023; WHO (2025) Suicide worldwide in 2021; UNODC (2023) Global Study on Homicide; Institute for Economics & Peace (2024) Global Terrorism Index
ask: Which danger do I fear most, and how many people does it kill in a year?

items.label: Terrorism
items.note: About 8,400 in 2023: under 2% of the toll from murder.

items.label: Murder
items.note: About 458,000 in 2021, by the UN's count.

items.label: Road crashes
items.note: About 1.2 million: the top killer of people aged 5 to 29.

items.label: Suicide
items.note: About 727,000: one and a half times murder, and rarely in the news.
